s.note: the light cycle races on the Grid
s.how: Melt 200g white chocolate and dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way. Set on baking paper. Mix icing sugar with a little water and blue colouring and pipe thin straight lines along each rod like light cycle trails. Let set before serving.

Cut dark rye bread into neat squares. Spread with creme fraiche and top with a fold of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a tiny squeeze of lemon. Lay them out in sharp rows on black slate, as clean as a nightclub inside a computer.

m.note: the glowing city on the Grid
m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs in a hot wok until browned. Add a sliced red capsicum and broccoli florets and cook 3 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with 3 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp honey until sticky and glossy.

w.note: the blue light of the programs
w.how: Dissolve 2 packets blue jelly in 250ml boiling water, then stir in 250ml cold lemonade instead of water. Pour into tall glasses and chill for 3 hours until set. Top with whipped cream and serve under a black light if you have one.

d.note: Kevin Flynn meditating in his hideout on the Grid
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water, then add 4 green tea bags. Pour over 1L water heated to just below boiling, about 80C, and steep for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour into small cups and serve plain.
